title: Crisp Dongbei-Style Meen in French Rice
description: A unique fusion dish that combines the bold flavors of Dongbei cuisine with the elegance of French cooking. Crispy meen is served atop a bed of flavorful rice, making for a truly unforgettable meal.

ingredients.name: dongbei
ingredients.notes: preferably cooked according to package instructions

instructions: Marinate the meen in exotic seasoning for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the meen until browned on both sides.
Transfer the meen to a baking dish and bake for 10-12 minutes or until cooked through.
Cook the lo and dongbei according to package instructions.
Combine the cooked lo and dongbei in a large serving dish.
Top the rice mixture with the crispy meen and garnish with additional exotic seasoning if desired.
